study_type_evidence.quote: GLP-ABD-XTEN144 and GLP-ABD-XTEN288 fusion proteins, dissolved in PBS, with a C-terminal His-tag were administered subcutaneously to the mice
An ELISA was used to determine the binding affinities of the fusion proteins to HSA
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS (Binding affinities of fusion proteins for HSA in vitro)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male C57BL/6, eight weeks old, approximately 20 g
in_vivo_species.quote: Sixty-two male C57BL/6 mice, aged eight weeks and weighing approximately 20 g, were maintained under a 12-h light/dark cycle at 25 °C

in_vitro_detail: Plate-based ELISA with immobilized human serum albumin and fusion proteins at 0.032-500 nM, detected with mouse anti-GLP-1 antibody and HRP-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG, to derive Kd. No cell-based receptor assay was performed.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: The plasma concentrations of GLP-ABD-XTEN fusion proteins ... The plasma concentrations of GLP-ABD-XTEN fusion proteins at different time points were determined by an ELISA method.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration versus time for both fusion proteins after a single 5 nmol/mouse subcutaneous injection, sampled at 1, 3, 7, 12, 18, 24, 30 and 36 h.

bioanalytical_method: Sandwich ELISA (immobilized anti-His-tag antibody for capture, rabbit monoclonal anti-GLP-1 antibody plus HRP-linked goat anti-rabbit IgG for detection), quantified against a standard curve; half-life from PK Solver in Microsoft Excel
bioanalytical_quote: immobilized anti-His-tag antibodies (ab18184, Abcam, UK) were used to capture the fusion proteins in plasma. The identification ... was accomplished using a monoclonal anti-GLP-1 antibody
notes: Only a fragment of each construct's primary sequence (the TEV-GLP-1 portion) is printed in the body; the ABD (46 aa) and XTEN144/XTEN288 sequences are described only by name and length, so the full sequences are not available from the body. The PK constructs retain a C-terminal His-tag that the efficacy constructs did not, and the PK dose (5 nmol/mouse s.c.) differs from the pharmacodynamic doses (3-30 nmol/kg). PK n = 3 per group. AUC(0-inf) was 20983.3 +/- 3374.3 h x ng/mL for XTEN144 and 18652.5 +/- 4269.7 h x ng/mL for XTEN288. Oral glucose (2 g/kg) is a challenge agent and is not listed as a test article.
